europe_now.title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
europe_now.summary: Ukraine launched over 600 drones targeting the Moscow region, causing injuries, while Russia retaliated with missile attacks, escalating the conflict. The strikes highlight the ongoing military tension between the two nations.

europe_now.title: Wildfires across Europe
europe_now.summary: Heatwaves have caused widespread wildfires in Europe, damaging historical sites like Monet's gardens in France. The fires pose significant risks to public safety and environmental stability.
